parameters.query:
SELECT r.article_id,
       r.title,
       r.url,
       r.source,
       to_char(r.published_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS published_date,
       r.raw_content
FROM raw_articles r
LEFT JOIN processed_articles p ON p.article_id = r.article_id
WHERE p.article_id IS NULL
  AND r.collected_at >= NOW() - make_interval(days => $1::int)
ORDER BY r.published_date DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT $2::int;

INSERT INTO processed_articles
  (article_id, title, source, url, published_date, category, summary, relevance_score, status, newsletter_week)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NULLIF($5, '')::date, NULL, NULL, NULL, $6, $7::date)
ON CONFLICT (article_id) DO UPDATE SET
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  newsletter_week = EXCLUDED.newsletter_week,
  processed_at = NOW()
RETURNING article_id, status;

messageValues.message: You are the editor of a professional AI industry newsletter. You analyze one news article and return structured data only. Be factual and neutral. Never invent facts that are not in the article.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO processed_articles
  (article_id, title, source, url, published_date, category, summary, relevance_score, status, newsletter_week)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NULLIF($5, '')::date, $6, $7, $8, 'scored', $9::date)
ON CONFLICT (article_id) DO UPDATE SET
  category        = EXCLUDED.category,
  summary         = EXCLUDED.summary,
  relevance_score = EXCLUDED.relevance_score,
  status          = 'scored',
  newsletter_week = EXCLUDED.newsletter_week,
  processed_at    = NOW()
RETURNING article_id, status;

-- Rank all articles of this newsletter week and mark the top N as 'selected'.
-- Re-running the workflow in the same week re-ranks cleanly (idempotent).
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT article_id
  FROM processed_articles
  WHERE newsletter_week = $1::date
    AND status IN ('scored', 'selected')
    AND relevance_score >= $2::numeric
  ORDER BY relevance_score DESC, published_date DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT $3::int
)
UPDATE processed_articles p
SET status = CASE WHEN p.article_id IN (SELECT article_id FROM ranked)
                  THEN 'selected' ELSE 'scored' END
WHERE p.newsletter_week = $1::date
  AND p.status IN ('scored', 'selected')
RETURNING p.article_id, p.title, p.source, p.url,
          to_char(p.published_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS published_date,
          p.category, p.summary, p.relevance_score, p.status;
